operations.body: All five Kummer relations are homogeneous quadrics, all 26 frozen walls are homogeneous linear forms, the canonical rational degree is -10, and the algebraic de Rham differential has degree zero under deg(dz)=deg(z).

operations.title: Benincasa reports graded five-site localized de Rham complex
operations.body: Entry 1293: after homogenization, all five Kummer relations are degree-two and all 26 frozen carrier walls degree-one. The full localized algebraic de Rham complex is graded, with canonical rational degree -10 and degree-zero differential. The grading survives carrier localization; the next possible failure is in the physical relative boundary/Gysin maps, not the absolute carrier algebra.
